name: /save
description: Save current work state as an event

steps.action: Ask the user for their current focus in one sentence
steps.context: Ask: 'In one sentence, what are you focused on right now?' Wait for the user's reply. This will be the main content of the checkpoint event.

steps.action: Write checkpoint event body to temp file

steps.description: Create event file and regenerate SESSION_CONTEXT

steps.action: If vault_sync shows success, note it briefly. If it failed, note it but do not block — the nightly cron will catch it.

steps.context: Confirm the event was created (show the path from the script output). Tell the user SESSION_CONTEXT was regenerated. Suggest: '/work' after a break, or '/daily-end' at end of day.
